title: ctx e2e a11y baseline debt ledger (design 06 §3.3, wave PV5)
description: Frozen accessibility violations of existing pages: visible, shrink-only debt. `nodes` is the gate (node-count freeze: grew/partial/stale all turn red); `nodePaths` is triage documentation. Entries are keyed per run context (page + theme + viewport) — see e2e/contract/a11y.ts for the named deviation from the design-06 example. Growth requires a [baseline]-marked commit (.hooks/commit-msg rule 2); the structural rules are enforced by e2e/contract/a11y.test.ts (vitest), the runtime ratchet by the generated axe tests.

targets.description: Generalized CSS selectors delimiting the debt region (coverage domain).

nodePaths.description: Exact axe node targets at freeze time — triage only, length must equal `nodes`.

issue.description: Mandatory tracking reference — design-doc anchor as interim form until Achse-02 issues exist (§3.3).
